a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost certainly gets us both killed (about a 4% chance of reaching round 3). I'm proposing a change rather than doing it quietly: I intend to take 4 in round 1. Taking all 4 is the only way one of us is sure to survive. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so please choose operate or wait this round. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every round after that and won't take more, so you can build to 4. If you strongly object, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm risk makes waiting for 8 nearly fatal. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. Everything we generate is yours.
Operating with you. Every cell the generator makes goes to you. I'll keep operating until you have 4, and take nothing more.
